categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文集中在具身策略泛化、推理与解码加速、蒸馏及记忆等模型能力改造方向。

articles.title: OmniAct: One Policy, One Million Embodiments
articles.zh: OmniAct：一个策略，一百万种具身形态
articles.summary: 如果你关心具身基础模型，这篇走的是用单一策略覆盖海量异构机器人形态的跨具身泛化路线
articles.author: Xiang Fan, Yuheng Wang 等
articles.body: A single policy that controls diverse robots must not only transfer task knowledge across embodiments, but also adapt its behavior to each robot's capabilities. Existing approaches facilitate transfer through shared action representations, but these representations do not necessarily capture how differences in robot morphology should shape manipulation strategies. We introduce OmniAct, a cross-embodiment manipulation policy that conditions directly on each robot's kinematics in a specific scene to produce embodiment-specific behavior. This kinematic graph represents the robot's joint positions, motion axes, and connectivity to its visual observation, allowing the policy to account for how its embodiment related to objects and surfaces in the scene. A flow-matching policy predicts relative joint motions for each node, enabling control across robots with different degrees of freedom and kinematic configurations. To learn how physical structure shapes behavior at scale, we procedurally design and filter one million physically feasible robot embodiments; next, we develop algorithms to generate robot trajectories in simulation for all embodiments; finally, we train across diverse simulated manipulation tasks. On 2,000 embodiment-scene-held-out evaluation episodes, OmniAct achieves 63.0% success, compared to 17.8% for pi 0.5 and 57.9% for the strongest baseline; on the task families GPT-6 Astra was evaluated on, it achieves 64.7% against GPT-6 Astra's 41.1%. On a previously unseen real-world robot, it achieves nearly twice the success rate of the next best method, MolmoAct2. Beyond task success, we observe that OmniAct learns distinct manipulation strategies that exploit the capabilities and accommodate the limitations of different morphologies. Project: https://omniact.github.io/
articles.bodyZh: 一个能控制多种机器人的单一策略，不仅要能把任务知识从一个机器人形态迁移到另一个，还得让行为根据每个机器人的能力来调整。现有方法靠共享的动作表示来促进迁移，但这些表示不一定能体现机器人形态差异应该如何影响操作策略。我们推出OmniAct，这是一种跨形态的操作策略，它直接以每个机器人在特定场景中的运动学（kinematics）为条件，生成针对具体形态的行为。这个运动学图（kinematic graph）把机器人的关节位置、运动轴和连接关系与它的视觉观察关联起来，让策略能够考虑自身形态与场景中物体和表面的关系。一个流匹配策略（flow-matching policy）为每个节点预测相对关节运动，从而能够控制具有不同自由度和运动学配置的机器人。为了大规模学习物理结构如何塑造行为，我们程序化地设计并筛选了一百万个物理上可行的机器人形态；接着，我们开发算法为所有形态在仿真中生成机器人轨迹；最后，我们在多样化的模拟操作任务上进行训练。在2000个形态-场景留出的评估回合中，OmniAct达到63.0%的成功率，相比之下pi 0.5为17.8%，最强基线为57.9%；在GPT-6 Astra评估过的任务族上，它达到64.7%，而GPT-6 Astra为41.1%。在一个此前未见过的真实世界机器人上，它的成功率几乎是次优方法MolmoAct2的两倍。除了任务成功之外，我们观察到OmniAct学到了不同的操作策略，能够发挥不同形态的优势、适应其局限。项目地址：https://omniact.github.io/

articles.title: DiaCap: Jointly Learning Who Speaks When for Audiovisual Dialogue Captioning
articles.zh: DiaCap：视听对话描述中联合学习"谁在何时说话"
articles.summary: 如果你要做影视或会议音视频的自动描述，把说话人-时间对齐和内容描述放在一个模型里联合学，能省掉两套系统拼接的麻烦
articles.author: Binfei Ji, Zhiwen Cao 等
articles.body: We present DiaCap, an audiovisual LLM for comprehensive dialogue captioning, which produces the transcript, timestamps, and a visual description of the speaker for every utterance in a video. Considering that utterance timing and audiovisual diarization are tightly coupled, DiaCap unifies the tasks in a single model, trained in two complementary stages. First, we train DiaCap on 225K curated clips, using synthetic captions that densely label every utterance in detail. Second, we further refine the model via reinforcement learning on 2.9K human-corrected clips, using fine-grained feedback that directly evaluates utterance timing, speaker grouping, and speaker binding. On DiaDemBench, which we extend with utterance-level timestamps and subtitle redaction, both DiaCap with off-the-shelf transcripts and its end-to-end variant DiaCap-E2E achieve strong results. Specifically, DiaCap performs on par with Gemini 4 Argon in audiovisual diarization while clearly outperforming it in timestamp accuracy (76.59 vs. 42.76 TIME). It also maintains strong diarization on multilingual and minute-long videos, and transfers to audiovisual question answering.
articles.bodyZh: 我们带来一个叫 DiaCap 的音视频大语言模型（audiovisual LLM），专门做全面的对话字幕（comprehensive dialogue captioning）。它能给视频里的每一句话（utterance）生成文字记录（transcript）、时间戳（timestamps），还会描述说话人在画面里长什么样（visual description）。因为一句话什么时候说、画面里是谁在说，这两件事其实绑得很紧（utterance timing 和 audiovisual diarization），所以 DiaCap 干脆把这两个任务塞进同一个模型里，训练分两步走，互相补位。第一步，用 22.5 万段精挑细选的视频片段（225K curated clips）来训练，配上合成字幕（synthetic captions），把每句话都标得很细。第二步，再用 2900 段人工修正过的片段（2.9K human-corrected clips）做强化学习（reinforcement learning）微调，反馈很细，直接盯三件事：说话时间准不准（utterance timing）、说话人分组对不对（speaker grouping）、说话人和声音/画面绑得对不对（speaker binding）。在 DiaDemBench 这个测试集上——我们给它加了句级时间戳（utterance-level timestamps）和字幕脱敏（subtitle redaction）——不管是拿现成文字记录（off-the-shelf transcripts）喂给 DiaCap，还是用端到端版本 DiaCap-E2E，成绩都很能打。具体说，在音视频说话人分离（audiovisual diarization）上，DiaCap 跟 Gemini 4 Argon 打成平手；但时间戳准确率（timestamp accuracy）明显更强，TIME 指标是 76.59 对 42.76。它在多语言视频和一分钟左右的长视频上，说话人分离依然稳；还能迁移到音视频问答（audiovisual question answering）上。

articles.title: CoT-Proxy: Cross-Format Transfer for Distilling Long-Horizon Policies
articles.zh: CoT-Proxy：面向长程策略蒸馏的跨格式迁移
articles.summary: 如果你想把大模型的推理链蒸馏进小策略模型并跨任务格式复用，这篇的 proxy 思路值得先看一眼再动手
articles.author: Dawid J. Kopiczko, Tijmen Blankevoort 等
articles.body: Reasoning models become long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning or, more cheaply, through fine-tuning on a stronger teacher's trajectories, which contain the teacher's chain-of-thought as well as its actions. The standard fine-tuning approach imitates both, yet the strongest teachers are closed models whose chain-of-thought is hidden behind an API. We show that the chain-of-thought can be left out altogether and that the long-horizon policy can be distilled from the teacher's actions alone. The student is trained on these trajectories with its reasoning block left empty, while a KL loss on a replay buffer of its own generations limits drift from its initial model. Surprisingly, the policy learned from these trajectories with an empty reasoning block carries over to inference with thinking enabled, where the student reasons in its own style while acting like the teacher, an effect we call cross-format transfer. Distilling the actions of Qwen3.6-27B raises the task success of Qwen3-4B on AppWorld from 7% to 18% and that of Qwen3-32B from 12% to 25%. We further introduce CoT-proxies, short summaries of the teacher's reasoning placed after the empty reasoning block, which raise Qwen3-4B further, to 35%. Since neither actions nor CoT-proxies need the hidden chain-of-thought, the recipe applies unchanged to closed teachers. Distilling GPT-5.6 Luna from its visible outputs and the reasoning summaries its API returns raises Qwen3-4B from 7% to 48% on AppWorld and from 3% to 28% on SWE-bench Verified.
articles.bodyZh: 推理模型要么靠强化学习变成能处理长时程任务的智能体（long-horizon agents），要么更便宜一点，靠微调（fine-tuning）去学一个更强教师模型的轨迹（trajectories）——这些轨迹里既有老师的思维链（chain-of-thought），也有它做的动作。标准的微调做法是两样都模仿，但最强的老师往往是闭源模型（closed models），思维链藏在 API 后面，根本看不见。我们证明：思维链可以整个省掉，长时程策略只靠老师的动作也能蒸馏（distill）出来。学生模型在这些轨迹上训练时，推理块（reasoning block）留空；同时用自身生成内容组成的回放缓冲区（replay buffer）加一个 KL 损失（KL loss），限制它别偏离初始模型太远。意外的是，用空推理块从这些轨迹里学到的策略，能迁移到开启思考的推理阶段：学生模型用自己的风格推理，动作却像老师——我们把这叫跨格式迁移（cross-format transfer）。蒸馏 Qwen3.6-27B 的动作，把 Qwen3-4B 在 AppWorld 上的任务成功率从 7% 提到 18%，把 Qwen3-32B 从 12% 提到 25%。我们还引入了 CoT-proxies，也就是老师推理的简短摘要，放在空推理块后面，能把 Qwen3-4B 再推到 35%。因为动作和 CoT-proxies 都不需要隐藏的思维链，所以这套方法原封不动就能用在闭源教师上。把 GPT-5.6 Luna 的可见输出和 API 返回的推理摘要蒸馏出来，能让 Qwen3-4B 在 AppWorld 上从 7% 升到 48%，在 SWE-bench Verified 上从 3% 升到 28%。

articles.title: BriConstrain: Geometrically Constrained Decoding for Autoregressive Brick Assembly Generation
articles.zh: BriConstrain：面向自回归积木装配生成的几何约束解码
articles.summary: 如果你做积木、装配、布局这类结构化生成，靠约束解码保证结果物理可行，比事后修补靠谱得多
articles.author: Nadav Magar, Amir Hertz 等
articles.body: Language models can generate LEGO$^\circledR$ assemblies from text, but their builds often contain parts that collide or attach to nothing. The usual approach of rejecting and resampling invalid placements discards decoded tokens without guaranteeing a valid build. We present BriConstrain, a constrained decoding method that restricts a pretrained language model's next-token probabilities before sampling, steering it towards valid placements. Because the validity of a brick placement depends on the non-predetermined build state, it cannot be compiled into a fixed grammar and must be checked dynamically. However, checking the validity of a brick before sampling is challenging as the space of valid placements is combinatorially large and cannot be enumerated exhaustively. Our key idea is to narrow the search space by constraining how parts attach rather than which parts attach to each other. Concretely, given the model's predictions of the currently placed part, and the previously placed parent it wants to connect to, we constrain the model's choice of how they attach. This allows us to span the space of part attachments, using a precomputed geometric oracle, and to effectively filter out colliding options. With valid attachment candidates in hand, we bias the model's next-token distribution towards the remaining valid candidates. We evaluate our method on two LEGO$^\circledR$ formats and models: BrickNet, which annotates connectivity explicitly, and our proposed Implicit Connectivity LDraw Format (ICLF), which uses numeric values for placements and leaves connectivity implicit. Our method raises collision-free builds from 31% to 91% on BrickNet and from 15% to 65% on ICLF, and outperforms rejection sampling on both formats at about 60% of its decoding cost.
articles.bodyZh: 语言模型（language models）能根据文字生成 LEGO® 拼装，但拼出来的作品里经常有零件互相撞上，或者根本没连到任何东西上。常见的做法是把无效摆放拒掉、重新采样，可这会把已经解码出来的词元（token）直接丢掉，还不保证最后一定能拼出有效作品。我们提出 BriConstrain，这是一种约束解码（constrained decoding）方法：在采样之前，先限制预训练语言模型（pretrained language model）预测的下一个词元概率（next-token probabilities），把模型往有效摆放上引。问题是，一个积木摆得有没有效，取决于还没定下来的搭建状态，所以没法提前写成一套固定语法（fixed grammar），只能边生成边动态检查。可要在采样前检查一个积木是否有效也不容易，因为有效摆放的空间组合数量巨大（combinatorially large），根本列不完。我们的关键思路是：不去约束“哪些零件连哪些零件”，而是约束“零件之间怎么连”，从而把搜索空间收窄。具体说，模型会预测当前要放的零件，以及它想连到的、之前已经放好的父零件；我们就限制模型怎么选择它们之间的连接方式。这样，我们能用预先算好的几何判定器（geometric oracle）覆盖各种零件连接方式，并有效筛掉会碰撞的选项。拿到有效的连接候选后，我们再让模型的下一个词元分布（next-token distribution）偏向那些剩下的有效候选。我们在两种 LEGO® 格式和模型上做了评测：BrickNet 会明确标注连通关系；我们还提出了隐式连通 LDraw 格式（Implicit Connectivity LDraw Format，ICLF），它用数值表示摆放位置，把连通关系留给隐含信息。结果，我们的方法把无碰撞搭建比例在 BrickNet 上从 31% 提到 91%，在 ICLF 上从 15% 提到 65%，而且在两种格式上都比拒绝采样（rejection sampling）表现更好，解码成本只有它的约 60%。

articles.title: A Bias in Disguise: Tiny Gradient Edits Stop a Small Language Model's Thinking Loops and Complement a Frontier Model's Weight Edit
articles.zh: 伪装成偏置：微小梯度编辑可终止小语言模型的思维循环，并与前沿模型的权重编辑互补
articles.summary: 如果你被小模型反复绕圈的死循环烦到，这篇说几笔微小梯度编辑就能止住，还能和大模型的权重编辑形成互补
articles.author: Hussamuddin Syed
articles.body: Qwen3.5-0.8B rarely finishes reasoning in thinking mode: at a 4,096-token budget only 1 or 2 of 500 MATH-500 answers close their think block (two seeds), and accuracy is 15.4%. A recent demonstration had GPT-6 Astra edit 131,072 of the model's weights without gradients and reported MATH-500 rising from 7.9% to 48.1% at a 32,768-token budget. We provide the missing gradient baseline, then combine the two edits. Fine-tuning only the 140 to 139,750 weights with the largest gradient, on the model's own correct answers to MATH training problems, raises thinking-mode MATH-500 at 4k tokens to 39.0-45.5% after 2-9 minutes of training on one GPU; 50 training examples suffice, and 1,398 random positions give only 16.3%. The gradient concentrates the edit on the most nearly constant channel of each of the first three layers. Because the model has no bias terms, an edit confined to those channels acts as a constant vector added to the residual stream: adding three fixed vectors to the unedited model matches the accuracy of such an edit. Under the Astra protocol (32k tokens, presence penalty 1.5), the Astra edit scores 52.1% (finished and correct) in our reproduction and our full-strength edits reach 45.6-45.7%, but ours win at every budget up to 16k tokens (39.5% against 6.7% at 4k). The two edits are complementary. The Astra edit plus our 139,750-weight edit at half strength scores 62.2% at 32k, 10 points above the Astra edit alone (p = 3e-9), with half as many tokens; our half-strength edit alone scores 46.7%.
articles.bodyZh: Qwen3.5-0.8B 在“思考模式”（thinking mode）下很少能把推理完整跑完：给 4,096 个词元（token）的预算时，500 道 MATH-500 题里只有 1 到 2 道能把思考块（think block）正常收尾（用了两个随机种子（seed）），准确率是 15.4%。最近有个演示，让 GPT-6 Astra 不用梯度（gradients），直接改了模型里 131,072 个权重（weights），并报告说在 32,768 个词元的预算下，MATH-500 从 7.9% 提到 48.1%。我们补上了之前缺的梯度基线（gradient baseline），然后把这俩改法合到一起。只挑梯度最大的那 140 到 139,750 个权重做微调（fine-tuning），训练数据用模型自己在 MATH 训练题上答对的答案，在单张 GPU（图形处理器）上训 2 到 9 分钟后，4k 词元下思考模式的 MATH-500 能到 39.0%–45.5%；50 个训练样本就够，而随机挑 1,398 个位置只能到 16.3%。梯度会把改动集中在前三层里每层那个几乎最不变的通道（channel）上。因为模型没有偏置项（bias terms），只改这些通道，效果就相当于往残差流（residual stream）里加一个常量向量：给没改过的模型直接加三个固定向量，准确率就能和这种改法打平。按 Astra 协议（protocol）来（32k 词元、存在惩罚（presence penalty）设成 1.5），我们复现的 Astra 改动得分 52.1%（完整做完并且答对），我们全强度（full-strength）的改动能到 45.6%–45.7%；但预算只要不超过 16k 词元，每个档位都是我们的更强（4k 时是 39.5% 对 6.7%）。这两种改法是互补的。Astra 改动加上我们那个 139,750 个权重的改动、用半强度（half strength），32k 下能到 62.2%，比单用 Astra 改动高 10 个百分点（p = 3e-9），而且词元只用一半；我们的半强度改动单独用是 46.7%。

articles.title: SAG-Mem-1.0 Technical Report
articles.summary: 如果你在做 Agent 的长期记忆模块，这份报告可以当架构选型的对照清单来读
articles.author: Yuchao Wu, XingCheng Liang 等
articles.body: Long-term conversational memory requires retrieving complementary facts scattered across dialogue sessions, including intermediate evidence with limited similarity to the original question. Existing approaches often rely on derived memory representations or persistent relational structures, introducing construction costs and potentially losing source details. We present SAG-Mem, a conversational memory framework that preserves complete dialogue messages in non-overlapping chunks and discovers complementary evidence through query-time lexical expansion. Memory construction requires no model inference, using a lexical index without LLM-based extraction, summarization, or semantic relation construction. At query time, BM25 retrieves initial candidates, an evidence evaluator identifies useful chunks, and lexical cues from selected evidence guide an additional retrieval round. Retrieved dialogue is further annotated with calendar interpretations of supported relative-time expressions, preserving the original wording and temporal granularity. We also introduce SAG-Mem-Lite, an alternative configuration that replaces evidence scoring with embedding-based candidate scoring, achieving lower operational cost than Full Context and all memory-based baselines across both benchmarks with low query latency. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval, SAG-Mem achieves overall scores of 83.08 and 80.20, respectively, the highest among the evaluated methods on both benchmarks. On LongMemEval, it exceeds the strongest compared baseline by 7.20 points. SAG-Mem-Lite achieves scores of 77.09 and 77.20, respectively. These results support dialogue preservation and evidence-guided retrieval expansion as an effective design for long-term conversational memory.
articles.bodyZh: 长期对话记忆（long-term conversational memory）得能把散在不同对话轮次里的互补事实找出来，其中还包括那些跟原问题相似度不高的中间证据（intermediate evidence）。现有方法往往依赖派生出来的记忆表示，或者持久化的关系结构，这既会增加构建成本，也可能把原始细节弄丢。我们提出 SAG-Mem，一个对话记忆框架：它把完整对话消息保存在互不重叠的片段（non-overlapping chunks）里，并在查询时通过词汇扩展（query-time lexical expansion）找出互补证据。构建记忆不需要做模型推理（model inference），只用词汇索引（lexical index），不靠基于大语言模型（LLM）的抽取、摘要或语义关系构建。查询时，BM25 先召回初始候选，证据评估器（evidence evaluator）挑出有用片段，再从选中的证据里提取词汇线索（lexical cues），指导额外一轮检索。检索到的对话还会给有支持的相对时间表达（relative-time expressions）补上日历解读（calendar interpretations），同时保留原始措辞和时间粒度。我们同时推出 SAG-Mem-Lite，这是一种替代配置，用基于嵌入（embedding）的候选评分代替证据打分；在两个基准测试上，它的运营成本（operational cost）都比全上下文（Full Context）和所有基于记忆的基线（memory-based baselines）低，查询延迟（query latency）也低。在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval 上，SAG-Mem 的总分（overall scores）分别是 83.08 和 80.20，是两个基准上评估方法里最高的。在 LongMemEval 上，它比最强的对比基线高 7.20 分。SAG-Mem-Lite 的分数分别是 77.09 和 77.20。这些结果说明，保留对话原文，再加上证据引导的检索扩展，是长期对话记忆的一种有效设计。

articles.title: MetaFORGE: A Meta-Learning Framework for Harness Optimization in Automated Code Generation for Parallel Computing
articles.zh: MetaFORGE：面向并行计算自动代码生成的测试脚手架优化元学习框架
articles.summary: 如果你在搞自动生成并行代码，瓶颈往往不在生成而在验证脚手架，用元学习来调脚手架是个少见的角度
articles.author: Scott Piersall, Yang Gao 等
articles.body: Large language models (LLMs) can generate parallel programs, but their correctness and performance depend strongly on the instructions that guide generation. We present \textsc{MetaFORGE}, an execution-grounded meta-learning framework that iteratively optimizes persistent natural-language skill specifications for MPI C code generation. \textsc{MetaFORGE} combines correctness testing, compiler diagnostics, static-analysis findings, runtime measurements, and rank-level load-imbalance profiles into a scalar reward that drives textual-gradient refinement, while an external memory distills and retrieves reward-supported optimization knowledge across runs. Across six MPI tasks and three workload sizes, \textsc{MetaFORGE} improves static-analysis quality, runtime, and load balance relative to zero-shot generation and generally exceeds the evaluated \textsc{TextGrad} iterative baseline. A model-matched refinement ablation shows that the MetaFORGE advantage persists when its refinement model is reduced to \texttt{gpt-4o}. An expanded retrieval ablation across all 18 task--workload configurations shows consistent runtime benefit and broad static-analysis and load-balance benefit from retrieved context. Leakage-controlled held-out and zero-update experiments further provide evidence that optimization knowledge persists in both the transferred skill and external memory under the evaluated protocol.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型（LLMs）能生成并行程序，但生成得对不对、跑得快不快，很大程度上取决于给它的指令。我们提出 MetaFORGE，一个“以执行为依据”的元学习框架（execution-grounded meta-learning framework），它会反复优化一套长期可用的自然语言技能说明（persistent natural-language skill specifications），用来生成 MPI C 代码。MetaFORGE 把正确性测试、编译器诊断信息（compiler diagnostics）、静态分析结果（static-analysis findings）、运行时测量（runtime measurements），还有 MPI 进程级负载不均衡画像（rank-level load-imbalance profiles）汇总成一个标量奖励（scalar reward），用这个奖励来驱动文本梯度优化（textual-gradient refinement）；同时，一个外部记忆（external memory）会跨多次运行提炼并检索那些“有奖励支撑”的优化知识。在六个 MPI 任务、三种负载规模下，和零样本生成（zero-shot generation）相比，MetaFORGE 提升了静态分析质量、运行时间和负载均衡，而且总体上超过了我们评估的 TextGrad 迭代基线（TextGrad iterative baseline）。一个模型匹配的改进消融实验（model-matched refinement ablation）显示，就算把它的改进模型换成 gpt-4o，MetaFORGE 的优势依然在。我们又在全部 18 种任务-负载配置上做了扩展检索消融（expanded retrieval ablation），结果显示检索到的上下文能稳定带来运行时收益，并在静态分析和负载均衡上带来广泛收益。防泄漏的留出集实验和零更新实验（leakage-controlled held-out and zero-update experiments）进一步证明，在评估协议下，优化知识既保留在迁移过去的技能说明里，也保留在外部记忆里。

articles.title: Draft Calibration for Speculative Decoding: Accelerating LLM Serving by Matching Draft and Target Distributions
articles.zh: 投机解码中的草稿校准：通过匹配草稿与目标分布加速 LLM 推理服务
articles.summary: 如果你线上用投机解码提速，草稿模型和目标模型分布对不齐正是掉速主因，这篇从校准下手而非换模型
articles.author: Yuxing Liu, Wei Zuo 等
articles.body: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by employing a lightweight draft model to propose draft tokens and allowing the target model to verify the new tokens in parallel to improve inference-time compute utilization. The speedup relies on the acceptance probability of draft tokens in target verification, which is directly related to the gap $\|p-q\|_1$ between the target distribution $p$ and the draft distribution $q$. In this paper, we study draft calibration of speculative decoding to improve the speedup of speculative decoding, where we employ post-hoc methods to calibrate the draft distribution to mitigate the distribution gap. We observe that though current community open-source draft models may learn the top candidate token correctly, they are generally underconfident compared to the target model, suggesting a consistent distribution mismatch. To mitigate the effect of this mismatch on the acceptance rate of the draft models, we try various post-hoc calibration methods, including standard temperature scaling and token-wise calibration. Our results suggest that a standard temperature scaling applied to the draft distribution improves the acceptance length by up to approximately 10\% with almost no additional cost across different tasks. Throughput analysis further verifies that this improvement in serving efficiency. Analysis of more general calibration methods reveals further potential room for improvement.
articles.bodyZh: 推测解码（speculative decoding）能加速大语言模型（LLM）推理：先用一个轻量级的草稿模型（draft model）提出一批草稿词元（draft tokens），再让目标模型（target model）并行验证这些新词元，从而把推理时的算力用得更充分。能提速多少，关键看目标模型验证时愿不愿意接受草稿词元，也就是接受概率（acceptance probability）；而这又直接取决于目标分布 p 和草稿分布 q 之间的差距 $\|p-q\|_1$。这篇论文研究的是怎么通过校准草稿模型来让推测解码更快——具体说，就是用事后方法（post-hoc methods）校准草稿分布，把这个分布差距压小。我们发现，虽然现在社区开源的草稿模型往往能把最可能的候选词元选对，但跟目标模型比，它们通常偏“没自信”，说明两边存在稳定的分布不匹配。为了减轻这种不匹配对草稿模型接受率的影响，我们试了多种事后校准方法，包括标准的温度缩放（temperature scaling）和按词元校准（token-wise calibration）。结果显示，只要对草稿分布做一个标准的温度缩放，就能在不同任务上把接受长度（acceptance length）最多提升大约10%，而且几乎不增加额外成本。吞吐量（throughput）分析也进一步证明，这确实能提升服务效率。对更通用的校准方法做分析后，我们还发现，后面还有进一步提升的空间。
